BJP leader Shaina NC faces backlash over torn Bal Thackeray photograph

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Shaina NC faced protests and demands for an FIR after she accidentally tore a photograph of Shiv Sena founder Bal Thackeray during a protest. The incident occurred during a Shiv Sena protest against a book by Sonia Gandhi. Uddhav Thackeray's Shiv Sena (UBT) and the Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) were involved in the protest where the photograph was torn. The Pioneer reported a row after the leader tore the photo, while Outlook India and The Free Press Journal also covered the controversy.
